title: Vintage Harkerware Currier A Home In The Wilderness Gold Trim Plate 6.25"
descriptionText:
Vintage Harkerware "A Home In The Wilderness" Gold Trim Plate

A charming mid-20th-century American pottery piece from Harker Pottery Co.,
featuring a rustic wilderness homestead scene in a Currier & Ives style,
finished with a gold trim border.

- Pattern: A Home In The Wilderness
- Maker: Harkerware (Harker Pottery Co., USA)
- Size: 6 1/4" diameter porcelain plate
- Trim: Gold rim
- Era: Mid-20th century

Pairs nicely with other Harkerware Currier & Ives pieces for a collector's
set. Please check photos closely for exact condition - ask any questions
before buying.
